subject: Unexpected embedding consumption spike / request for credit
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@indexly.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@indexly.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden embedding usage spike on Nov 18-19 — please investigate

Hi Jasmine,

Looks like Indexly saw a sharp jump in embedding-related consumption on Nov 18 around 21:00 UTC and again Nov 19 02:00 UTC. Our finance team pulled the attached invoice and a small sample of requests (usage_spike_sample.csv) — you can see the same client job id repeated roughly 2x for short time windows. Our month-to-date spend is 3.6x the expected run rate.

Can you confirm whether this is a billing/meters issue or something on our side (we're running a vectorization pipeline that dedupes, but suspect retries doubled requests)? We need either an explanation or a one-time credit while we investigate.

Attachments: indexly_invoice_nov.pdf (PDF of current invoice), usage_spike_sample.csv (CSV with timestamps and request ids)

Thanks,
Emma Park
Head of Infrastructure
Indexly, Inc.
emma@indexly.ai

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice/sample. I'm looping in Monica from Billing and Sean from Finance so we can triage quickly. High-level plan:

- Monica will pull the token-level records for the timestamps you shared and check for duplicate request ids or system retries on our side.
- If it's a platform-side duplication or an ingestion retry we caused, we'll propose a provisional credit and update the invoice.
- If it's client-side replays we can show logs and help point to mitigations, but will treat credit requests case-by-case.

Can you confirm the internal job id you saw in the CSV is "idx-job-77a"? That will help us map logs. Also if you can share any server-side retry IDs or the full request ids (not just truncated), that would speed up matching.

I want to get you an initial update within 24 hours.

— Jasmine Liu

Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Emma Park <emma@indexly.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden embedding usage spike on Nov 18-19 — please investigate

Hi all — I pulled the token-level ledger for Indexly for Nov 17–20 and matched against the request ids Emma provided. Initial findings:

1) We see duplicated requests originating from the same client IP for a ~19-minute window (2026-11-18T21:04:00Z — 2026-11-18T21:23:00Z). The server logs contain repeated POSTs where a downstream retry header is present (Redwood-retry: 1).

2) The duplicate requests resulted in two separate embedding jobs being scheduled; our autoscaler provisioned additional capacity and both jobs were executed, producing token counts that appear duplicated in the invoice.

3) The total duplicated tokens for that window are ~1.2M tokens (embeddings unit). That accounts for ~45% of the spike on Nov 18 and similar pattern for the Nov 19 window (smaller magnitude).

Recommendation:
- Provisional one-time credit for the duplicated tokens while Indexly investigates their retry behavior.
- Credit amount proposed: $12,450 (calculated as duplicated token units * embedding rate).
- We'll mark the invoice as disputed and issue an adjusted invoice draft; final credit will be applied after Emma confirms.

Attached: token_report_20261119.csv (token-level rows for matched request ids).

Emma — if you approve, I can open a refund/credit workflow and we will update the invoice and HubSpot deal. Sean — FYI for ledger/financial posting.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

<Ticket created: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/8342>
From: Emma Park <emma@indexly.ai>

Hi Monica / Jasmine — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the token report. I reviewed the token_report_20261119.csv and can confirm the duplicate request ids match our job runner's retry attempts after a transient DB timeout. We will patch the retry behavior to dedupe locally.

We approve the proposed one-time credit of $12,450. Please proceed with the adjustment and send an updated invoice so our accounting team can reconcile.

Also — can you include a short explanation line on the adjusted invoice referencing "duplication due to repeated ingestion attempts" so our AP team has context?

Emma Park
Head of Infrastructure
Indexly, Inc.
